<problem>
Given a string S, count the number of distinct, non-empty subsequences of S .

        dp[ord(S[i]) - ord('a')] = (dp[ord(S[i]) - ord('a')] + dp[ord(S[i - 1]) - ord('a')]) % mod
    return sum(dp) % mod
```
